headline: President Obama created a White House Office of Health Reform to coordinate the administration's work on changing the U.S. health care system.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a new office inside the White House focused on health reform. Based on the title, the office's job was to organize and coordinate the administration's health reform efforts. No summary was provided, so details about the office's specific duties, staff, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle health programs
who_it_affects.how: They would likely work with the new White House office as it coordinated health reform efforts across the government.
